The '''''Green Asteroid''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]], and a trader in the [[Polesotechnic League]]. [[Whiplash]] had arranged for the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Dejah Duare]] to take the ship home to [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]. Dejah, however, opted to stay on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
